name: The Notifier – Phone Alerts
author: thenotifier

sections.description:
thenotifier-alerts connects your WooCommerce store to The Notifier so customers can join alert groups from your storefront and receive push notifications when you send store broadcasts or when products restock.

What this plugin does

  • Connection — Secure API key storage (encrypted when possible) for The Notifier production API.
  • Store alerts — Create, schedule, edit, and cancel store-wide push alerts from wp-admin.
  • Product alerts — Map products/variations to Notifier groups; restock detection submits alerts through the existing Notifier scheduler.
  • Storefront — Administrator-configurable store and product button labels with personalized join links and desktop QR (block, shortcode, classic templates).
  • Activity — Queue diagnostics and redacted export for support.
  • Dashboard link — Opens the Notifier web app in a new tab for billing and API keys (not an iframe).

Customer join links always use thenotifier.app, never the SaaS dashboard hostname.

External service

Connecting sends configuration and alert data to The Notifier API. Push delivery, group membership, and billing are handled by The Notifier service and mobile apps. See Privacy section below.

Compatibility

Declares compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (custom order tables) and Cart/Checkout blocks. Does not modify checkout or read orders.

Privacy

  • Logged-in customers receive an opaque join reference UUID in user meta when they tap a store or product alert join button.
  • Guests may receive a signed HttpOnly cookie (~90 days) after an explicit join click.
  • Tools → Export/Erase Personal Data includes local join references for registered users.
  • Shortcode [thenotifier_alerts_forget_guest] clears the guest browser cookie only (does not unsubscribe phones).
  • Uninstall can retain or remove local tables — see Connection → Privacy & uninstall.
  • Erasing WordPress data does not delete Notifier app memberships or remote schedules. Service privacy: thenotifier.app/legal/privacy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the-notifier-phone-alerts.zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload, or copy the the-notifier-phone-alerts folder to wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate on a single site (network-wide activation is not supported).
  3. Ensure WooCommerce 9.0+ is active.
  4. Open WooCommerce → Connection, enter your API key from thenotifier.app, and connect.
  5. Optionally customize both global storefront button labels under WooCommerce → Connection → Storefront button labels.
  6. Add the store join block/shortcode and configure product restock alerts as needed.

Build from source: see CHANGELOG.md and scripts/build-assets.mjs in the plugin package.
sections.faq:
Does activation call The Notifier API?

No. You connect explicitly from WooCommerce → Connection.

Does uninstall cancel remote alerts?

No. Uninstall removes local WordPress data only (unless you chose to retain it). Remote groups and schedules remain until changed in the Notifier app or via Notifier support.

Where do customers join?

On thenotifier.app via links returned by the API — not inside wp-admin.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Initial release: connection, storefront join/QR, store and product alerts, restock pipeline, Activity, privacy tools, dashboard link. See CHANGELOG.md in the plugin directory.
